question: Which power is to be worshipped and what does it accomplish?
premises: The supreme will-power, named as the awakener of the three powers, is to be worshipped.
Its action shatters the support of time.
inference: Worship of the supreme will-power, which awakens the three powers, results in the drawing in of all and the collapse of time's foundation.
plain_english: The supreme will-power, by name the awakener of the three powers, is to be worshipped; it draws in all and shatters the very support of time.
